# Break with if...else Statement

#### Course: Learn C Programming

## Break with if...else Statement

Let's write another example where the loop is terminated after the third iteration using break.

```c
1#include <stdio.h>
2
3int main() {
4
5  for (int i = 1; i < 6; ++i) {
6
7    if(i == 3){
8        break;
9    }
10
11    printf("%d\n", i);
12  }
13
14  printf("This is outside the loop.");
15
16  return 0;
17}
```

Output

```text
1
2
This is outside the loop.
```

![Break with if...else Statement](data:image/png;base64,)

This is the same as running the loop with the condition i<=2 since the loop is terminated after i=3.
